description: Get full details for one tracked app in the caller's Sonar workspace: store metadata plus up to 90 daily snapshots of rating, review count, version, and installs. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts).

app_id.description: Sonar app UUID — the `id` returned by sonar_list_apps or sonar_create_product. NOT a store id.

name: sonar_get_app
title: Get Tracked App
